title: This is my first game that is actually on the way to release, but now I need feedback. Playtest is OUT NOW !
author: Chanclink_

comments.author: Chanclink_
comments.body:
Hello everyone !

I've set myself one year to finish and publish a game on steam. I've never been this far on a project, and I'm happy I've gotten out of the prototype hell.

In Smoothie Chaos, you raise cute little slimes just to mix them and make smoothies out of them.  
The game is all about managing those slimes and your customers and discovering what those goofballs can do ! Some will be harder to contain but make you earn big while some will even help you manage your smoothie shop... if you take good care of them of course !

The playtest of the game just got out now ! So go wishlist the game and you can even play it right now : [https://store.steampowered.com/app/5396320/Smoothie\_Chaos/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5396320/Smoothie_Chaos/)

The game is still midway in terms of development, SFX are a mess and there are still ai generated placeholders. AI was used in the creation of this game, mostly for code and 3D modelling as well as the UI. If that's a turn off I get it and you have all the right to, and that's why I want to disclose it.

Any feedback is appreciated !

comments.author: bobmefred
comments.body: i think this is exactly the sort of madness ai should be used for, no idea if it will sell though.  Is the blending sequence done with ai?  looks pretty good

replies.author: Chanclink_
replies.body: Yes ! Thank you ! I'm pretty proud of the blending animation yeah, the sound design is not exactly it though, it was made with AI, both the blender and the animation.

replies.author: QuestHouseGM
replies.body: Did it blend the blending animations for the blender in Blender?

replies.author: Chanclink_
replies.body: Haha, well actually the animation is made with shaders or with scripts inside godot, but the blender was made... well in blender
